title: My pet camera showed two shapes on the sofa 🐈

hook_text: At 3:30 in the morning my pet camera showed two shapes on the sofa.

scenes.narration: At 3:30 in the morning my pet camera showed two shapes on the sofa.
I live alone, with a cat. The camera showed her on the armchair. And on the sofa, two long shapes, sitting side by side, facing a television that was off.
I pressed the speaker button. Hello? On the screen, both shapes turned their heads. Slowly, towards the camera.
Then the cat jumped down, and walked to the sofa. And sat between them. Just like she did every night, with me.
My stomach dropped. Every night. I had always thought she sat beside me.
I replayed the footage. At 3:12 they came in through the closed door, and sat the way a family sits. One of them tilted its head, copying the angle my own head makes when I watch the news.
The shapes stood. One of them lifted a hand and waved, at the camera, at me. And the speaker whispered, in my own voice. Please come home soon. We moved the furniture.
So tell me. Do you go home, or stay away?
